columns.name: gid
columns.description: Globally unique identifier of the AuditLogEvent

columns.name: event_category
columns.description: The category that this event_type belongs to.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: The entity that triggered the event. Will typically be a user.

columns.name: resource
columns.description: The primary object that was affected by this event.

columns.name: context
columns.description: The context from which this event originated..

dataFlows.transformKql:
source
| extend TimeGenerated = todatetime(created_at)
 | extend ActorType = tostring(actor.actor_type), ActorEmail = tostring(actor.email), ActorGid = tostring(actor.gid), ActorName = tostring(actor.name), ApiAuthenticationMethod = tostring(context.api_authentication_method), SrcIpAddr = tostring(context.client_ip_address), ContextType = tostring(context.context_type), UserAgent = tostring(context.user_agent), OauthAppName = tostring(context.oauth_app_name), RuleName = tostring(context.rule_name), ResourceEmail = tostring(resource.email), ResourceGid = tostring(resource.gid), ResourceName = tostring(resource.name), ResourceSubType = tostring(resource.sub_type), ResourceType = tostring(resource.type)
 | extend Src = SrcIpAddr
